summary.en: Hezbollah chief again demanded Lebanon release five detained operatives while rejecting any post-UNIFIL force outside U.N. authority, and he reiterated that Iran works for Hezbollah. Israeli warplanes intensified low-altitude flights over southern Lebanon and the Nabatieh region and Israel opposed French troop deployment in south Lebanon, warning it would grant Hezbollah freedom of movement. Israeli airstrikes hit the town of Hadatha and Israeli forces shelled, demolished and swept southern Lebanon, while a Jordanian sailor’s body was recovered near the UAE coast after a tanker attack. The conflict has caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Hezbollah-lederen krevde igjen at Libanon frigir fem tilbakeholdte operatører, samtidig som han avviste enhver styrke utenfor FN-myndighet etter UNIFIL, og han gjentok at Iran arbeider for Hezbollah. Israels krigfly intensiverte lavhøydeflyvninger over sørlige Libanon og Nabatieh-regionen, og Israel motsatte seg fransk tropputplassering i sørlige Libanon, og advarte at dette ville gi Hezbollah fri bevegelse. Israels luftangrep rammet byen Hadatha, og israelske styrker shellet, rev ned og feide gjennom sørlige Libanon, mens kroppen til en jordansk sjømann ble funnet nær UAE-kysten etter et tankangrep. Konflikten har forårsaket 4 335 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)
background.extract: An ongoing conflict between the Lebanese militant group Hezbollah and Israel began on 8 October 2023, when Hezbollah launched rockets and artillery at Israeli positions following Hamas's October 7 attacks on Israel. The conflict escalated into a prolonged exchange of bombardments, leading to extensive displacement in Israel and Lebanon. The conflict is part of the broader Middle Eastern crisis that began with Hamas's attack, with the short Israeli invasion of Lebanon in 2024 marking the largest escalation of the Hezbollah–Israel conflict since the 2006 Lebanon War. In Arabic, the conflict (2023–2024) is referred to as the "Support War" or the "Gaza Support War."
